stories.headline: Meloni calls Olympics protesters and railway saboteurs 'enemies of Italy'
stories.summary: Prime Minister Meloni strongly condemned anti-Olympics protesters and railway saboteurs during the Milano Cortina 2026 opening, calling them 'enemies of Italy and Italians.' The protests and infrastructure attacks coincided with the Olympic Games launch, prompting security concerns.

articles.title: Meloni: 'Chi manifesta contro i Giochi è nemico dell'Italia'
Italy's Meloni condemns anti-Olympics protesters in Milan
Meloni slams 'enemies of Italy' for railway sabotage and anti-Olympics protests

stories.headline: President Mattarella attends Olympics, meets athletes and watches Brignone's gold medal win
stories.summary: President Mattarella attended multiple Olympic events at Milano Cortina 2026, meeting with athletes including Sofia Goggia and calling Arianna Fontana. He was present when Federica Brignone won gold in the SuperG, creating memorable moments with Italian Olympic champions.

articles.title: Mattarella abbraccia Brignone: "Io ci contavo". L'atleta azzurra emozionata
Milano Cortina: Mattarella incontra Sofia Goggia e parla con Arianna Fontana

stories.headline: Meloni government approves naval blockade powers against migrants and new security package
stories.summary: The Italian cabinet approved legislation authorizing naval blockades to halt migrant boats during periods of 'exceptional pressure' at borders. The broader security package includes extended detention powers for police and other measures to combat irregular immigration and maintain public order.

articles.title: Italy's Meloni moves to allow naval blockades against migrants
Italian PM vows to secure borders and approves bill allowing naval blockades

stories.headline: Meloni attends Italy-Africa Summit in Ethiopia, skipping Munich Security Conference
stories.summary: Prime Minister Meloni chose to attend the second Italy-Africa Summit in Addis Ababa rather than the Munich Security Conference, marking the first time the summit was held in Africa. She promoted the 'Piano Mattei' for Italian-African cooperation and offered debt suspension mechanisms for climate-affected countries.

articles.title: Meloni non va a Monaco ma in Etiopia per il vertice Italia-Africa: "Pagina nuova"
Italian PM Meloni offers climate‑shock debt suspension for African states

stories.headline: Roberto Vannacci leaves Lega to form new party 'Futuro Nazionale'
stories.summary: General Roberto Vannacci broke from the Lega party to establish a new political movement called 'Futuro Nazionale,' taking several parliamentarians with him. The split creates tensions within the center-right coalition and raises questions about electoral alliances.

articles.title: Futuro Nazionale: lo statuto di Vannacci contro gender, woke e immigrazionismo
"Una legge anti traditori". La vendetta della Lega per l'addio di Vannacci

stories.headline: Italy to participate as observer in Trump's Board of Peace initiative
stories.summary: Prime Minister Meloni announced Italy will likely join President Trump's 'Board of Peace' as an observer, with Foreign Minister Tajani set to participate in the February 19 Washington meeting focused on Gaza reconstruction and regional stability.

articles.title: Italy Likely to Join Trump Board of Peace as Observer: Meloni
Tajani riferisce in Parlamento sul Board of Peace

stories.headline: Justice referendum campaign intensifies with Fratelli d'Italia mobilization
stories.summary: Fratelli d'Italia launched an intensive campaign for the 'Yes' vote in the constitutional referendum on judicial reform, with party leadership calling it a national interest. The campaign includes controversial social media content and faces opposition criticism.

articles.title: FdI in campo: 'Se vince il no un problema per il governo'
Fratelli d'Italia e villains per il referendum sulla giustizia: autogol social

stories.headline: Monte dei Paschi insider trading investigation involves Treasury official
stories.summary: Stefano Di Stefano, a Treasury Ministry director and MPS board member, was investigated for insider trading and subsequently resigned. The case involves suspected use of privileged information related to the MPS-Mediobanca merger operation.

articles.title: Mps, si dimette da consigliere Di Stefano, indagato per insider trading
Il dirigente del ministero dell'Economia Stefano Di Stefano è indagato per insider trading

stories.headline: NATO command structure changes as Italy takes over Naples hub
stories.summary: NATO announced a redistribution of command responsibilities, with Italy assuming leadership of the Joint Force Command Naples while the UK takes over Norfolk. The change reflects European allies taking greater roles in the alliance structure.

articles.title: Nato, le basi di Napoli e Virginia agli alleati: gli Usa cedono il comando
Nato, un altro passo indietro Usa: le basi di Napoli e Norfolk passano agli alleati

stories.headline: Armed assault on armored vehicles in Puglia leads to arrests and security concerns
stories.summary: A heavily armed commando attempted to rob armored vehicles on the Brindisi-Lecce highway, leading to shootouts with Carabinieri and two arrests. The incident highlighted ongoing security challenges from organized crime groups specializing in armored vehicle attacks.

articles.title: Assalto a portavalori nel Brindisino, sparatoria con i carabinieri: due fermati
Assalto "paramilitare" nel segno delle mafie a caccia di 6 milioni di euro: convalidati i due fermi

stories.headline: PD referendum video controversy using Olympic athletes sparks criticism
stories.summary: The Democratic Party faced criticism for using images of Olympic curling champions Amos Mosaner and Stefania Constantini in a video promoting the 'No' vote in the justice referendum. The athletes objected and the video was subsequently removed after protests from sports authorities.

articles.title: Referendum giustizia, il Pd posta un video per il «no» con gli atleti olimpici. Rimosso dopo le proteste degli azzurri
Il Pd usa gli atleti-poliziotti per lo spot per il No al referendum

stories.headline: Sanremo and media controversies involving political figures
stories.summary: Andrea Pucci withdrew from co-hosting Sanremo after political criticism, prompting debate about media censorship. Related controversies involved other TV personalities and accusations of political bias in RAI programming, with Meloni condemning what she called 'illiberal drift.'

articles.title: Italian PM Meloni slams 'illiberal drift' after comedian quits TV show
Andrea Pucci e il cabaret all'italiana, quando il coraggio del maschio italico batte in ritirata

stories.headline: Marina Berlusconi signals need for renewal in Forza Italia leadership
stories.summary: Marina Berlusconi gave an interview suggesting Forza Italia needs to enter a 'new phase' while expressing gratitude to current leader Antonio Tajani. Her comments were interpreted as subtle pressure for party renewal and generated internal discussions about future leadership.

articles.title: Marina Berlusconi torna a incalzare Tajani. Ecco cosa potrebbe cambiare in Forza Italia
CAOS FORZA ITALIA/ Tajani di nuovo scaricato da Marina Berlusconi

stories.headline: Banking sector reports record profits amid rising costs for customers
stories.summary: Italy's major banks reported strong financial results with Banca Generali posting record profits and MPS announcing successful integration plans with Mediobanca. However, customers face rising fees and reduced services, with studies showing increased costs for basic banking operations.

articles.title: Utili record ma costi alti per i correntisti: perché le banche sono sempre più "ricche"
Mps, utili in aumento a 2,75 miliardi e integrazione con Mediobanca. Lovaglio: "Siamo alla svolta"
